issues: 整镜头在 480×270 设计坐标里排版再放大，文档是灰色骨架条、药丸名称 12px 级，说明句只有 11px，全片几乎没有能读的字
浅灰底 + 白卡 + 灰字，没有强调色和光，画面平且空，右侧一半画面长时间空着
药丸只是在原位弹出，和左侧文档没有任何联系，"结论从文档里来"这件事看不出来
说明句淡出后画面只剩三个药丸，尾帧没有信息落点
changes: look 换成 porcelain（冷白 + 钴蓝 + 青绿点缀），原生 1920 排版：出版级"客户档案"文档（标题 52px / 正文 30px）、128px 高结论药丸（名称 54px + 渐变图标 + 匹配度 chip）、说明句 44px
开场加"在读"的交代：文档居中，一道钴蓝扫描光带自上而下扫过整页（裁在纸面圆角内），眉题 ANALYZING · 12 SOURCES
因果链：每张药丸先让依据句被钴蓝荧光笔划出，再从这句话的位置飞出、overshoot 14f 落进右栏槽位（飞行按速度模糊），最后一条钴蓝细线从句尾连到药丸
保留节奏骨架：驻留 18→46f（只露约 40%、scale 0.92）、发牌间隔 38f、透明度先到位移后到；文档全程 1.4px/f 连续滚动，纸面上下渐隐
说明句逐词由灰到墨 + 上浮，下一张前上移淡出；末句留到底，尾帧是三条结论 + 一句理由的完整画面（时长 174f → 180f）
issuesEn: The whole shot was laid out in 480x270 design units and scaled up: the document was grey skeleton bars, pill labels were ~12px class and captions 11px, so almost nothing was readable
Light grey floor, white cards and grey text with no accent or light: flat and empty, with the right half of the frame idle for long stretches
Pills simply popped in place with no link to the document, so "the conclusions come from the document" never showed
After the captions faded only three pills remained, leaving the last frame without a point
changesEn: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt, a teal accent) with native 1920 layout: a publication-grade account review document (52px title, 30px body), 128px-tall conclusion pills (54px names, gradient icons, match chips) and 44px captions
An opening that shows reading: the document starts centred while a cobalt scan band sweeps down the page (clipped to the paper corners) under an ANALYZING · 12 SOURCES kicker

A visible chain of cause: before each pill the evidence sentence gets a cobalt highlighter stroke, then the pill flies out from that line and lands in its right-column slot with a 14f overshoot (speed blur in flight), and a cobalt line draws from the sentence end to the pill
The rhythm skeleton is kept: park at 18-46f (about 40% visible, scale 0.92), 38f between pills, opacity before position; the document scrolls continuously at 1.4px/f with soft top and bottom fades
Captions darken word by word from grey to ink with a small rise and slide out before the next pill; the last one stays, so the final frame shows three conclusions and one reason (174f to 180f)
